reponse: Since PR #447, the flag is served by the API, so the old advice of setting `FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash` in `.env.local` is outdated and ignored [2]. To enable the new dashboards locally, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` with the API running, then hard-reload the page [3]. You can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3]. The flag was also renamed from `new_dash` to `dashboards_v2` [2]. Note that new workspaces with no events may show a blank grid until the empty states land [5].
